title: Driver Standards Bulletin: Agreement Standing and Insurance Binder Acceptance
content:
**Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing.** The standing of a Wayfare driver agreement on the day support records an insurance binder bears on the binder acceptance days, the calendar days from the recording day for which the binder is accepted as the auto insurance on file.

**Standard.** On an agreement deactivated with its deactivation date on or before the recording day, the binder acceptance days change by -6 days (6 days fewer); on an agreement on hold with its hold start date on or before the recording day, they change by -3 days (3 days fewer); on an agreement in any other standing, they do not change.

The standing is read from the agreement's status together with its deactivation date or hold start date, as the agreement shows them on the recording day.

| Agreement status | Date condition | Change |
|---|---|---|
| deactivated | deactivation date on or before the recording day | -6 |
| on hold | hold start date on or before the recording day | -3 |
| active, or any other standing | not read | 0 |

**Readings (hypothetical, recording day 2026-07-01).**
- On hold since 2026-05-20: -3.
- Deactivated on 2026-06-15: -6.
- Active: no change.
